plan: A jungler on her boar who charges and freezes her enemies.
aSurveiller: Her R (Glacial Prison). She stuns the first champion hit and creates a storm that slows around it: spread out.
contrer: Stay behind your allies: her R freezes the first one hit.
Spread out: her R storm slows around it.
Avoid trading near her: her hits apply frost.

sorts.E: Freezes and stuns a frost-stacked target.
sorts.R: Bola that freezes and creates a storm.
